items.evidence: E1/E0 and E2/E0 carbon direction is negative on all 7 daily strata under all three mappings; high-stress water is a four-of-seven-day component, not claimed as daily universal.
Regional hub coefficients are mechanism scenarios and are not facility, operator, or user observations.
The Azure code-service trace is a public production trace subset and is not the full GenAI workload population.
No regression conditioning or cross-sectional association model is used.
All 16,803,695 rows, zero invalid rows, token quantiles, timestamp span, and mapping coverage are reported.
No extreme-value selection followed by pre/post measurement is used.
Azure trace fields do not provide request success/failure labels; it is treated as observed trace demand, not universal completed service.
E0/E1/E2 endpoints, bootstrap seed, block length, and thresholds were frozen before complete Azure trace inspection; interpolation analyses are labeled exploratory.
This is a reconstruction after the old v34 failure and is not a preregistered confirmatory study.
Claims are limited to model-generated mechanism directions; no policy causal effect or Azure operator outcome is claimed.
The Azure timestamp sequence supplies demand ordering only; it is not used to infer environmental causal direction.
